families.title: Weekly top-N portfolio
families.plain: Every Friday rank heavily shorted stocks (days-to-cover >= 5, price >= $3) by a score, hold the top N equally weighted for the next week.
families.notes: Execution at Monday (next session) open, 12 bps per side on replaced names; weekly name returns capped at +500% (48 cases) to guard against bad prints.

caveats: Survivorship bias: delisted/bankrupt names mostly have no Yahoo history, so long results are flattered and short results understated for the worst blow-ups.
FINRA short interest is lagged 9 business days; revisions and holiday release dates are not modelled exactly.
94 variants were tried across 5 families. Only the in-sample winner per family was scored out of sample; with this many tries some in-sample winners will look good by chance.

Short trades assume shares are always available to borrow at 35%/yr; real hard-to-borrow names can cost far more, be recalled, or be unborrowable, and losses on shorts are unlimited (gaps through stops).
Trades are independent per ticker (one position at a time) and do not model portfolio capital limits, halts, or slippage beyond 12 bps.
Past results do not predict future ones. Not financial advice.
